name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Library code that decrements a short counter reached through a pointer, then uses the new counter value as an index into a table found through a pointer in the same structure. It stores two register values into that table entry and returns one.

name: allocate_and_initialise_record
description: Library routine that allocates a fixed-size record with a special flag, sets up an internal buffer inside it, and runs a sequence of calls to initialise it. If any step fails it frees the record and returns zero; otherwise it returns the record.

name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Empty library routine with no body that only returns. It is called from one other routine.

name: call_library_routine_return_zero
description: Library wrapper that calls a routine through the library vector, discards the result, and returns zero.

name: forward_call_with_offset
description: Library routine that adds a fixed offset of 78 to its second parameter and passes both parameters on to another routine. It returns nothing.

name: find_value_after_equals
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of strings, testing each entry against the key with a called routine. On a match it returns a pointer to the text just after the equals sign, or zero if no entry matches.

name: scan_list_for_equals_sign
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of strings and checks each one with a called routine and for an equals sign at the matching position. It returns a pointer to the text after the equals sign, or zero if the list ends first.

name: search_string_list_for_match
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of pointers, passing each entry to a called routine and checking the result together with an equals sign at the matching position. It returns a pointer past the equals sign, or zero when the list is exhausted.

name: test_bar_segment_for_match
description: Repeatedly finds the next vertical bar character in a string with a called routine and measures the segment before it. It returns one when a segment matches the expected length and a further check passes, and zero when the string ends.

name: search_bar_segments_from_offset
description: Starting at a given position, scans a string segment by segment separated by vertical bars, comparing each segment length with a target value. It returns one when a segment matches and the extra check passes, or zero when no segments remain.

name: search_bar_segments_for_match
description: Loops over bar-separated segments of a string, using several called routines to locate each separator, measure the segment and test it against the target length. It returns one on a successful match and zero when the string ends.

name: continue_bar_segment_search
description: Advances from the current bar separator to the next segment of a string, measures it, and compares its length with the target. It returns one when the length matches and the extra check passes, and zero when the string ends.

name: search_bar_segments_for_length
description: Scans bar-separated segments of a string from the start, comparing each segment length with a target and running a further check on a match. It returns one when a segment matches and zero when no segments remain.

name: parse_copy_prefix_into_record
description: Clears a status byte in a record, then checks whether the text starts with the word copy. It stores the text directly for a single copy, or reads a decimal count and stores the count and the remaining text in the record, then returns the record.

name: parse_count_digits_then_finish
description: Reads a decimal count from a fixed position in a text, checks the text after it against a fixed string, and then calls two cleanup routines whichever way the check goes. It returns nothing.

name: parse_digits_and_check_suffix
description: Reads a run of decimal digits from the current text position into a number, then checks the characters after the digits against a fixed string. It calls two cleanup routines and returns nothing, whether the check passed or not.

name: parse_number_then_check_suffix
description: Accumulates decimal digits from the current text position into a count, then checks the text after the digits against a fixed string. It calls two cleanup routines and returns nothing, whichever way the check goes.

name: convert_digit_char_to_value
description: Converts a character in the range of codes for the digits zero to nine into its numeric value. Any other character gives minus one.

name: return_minus_one_constant
description: Library routine with no work to do that returns minus one.

name: call_library_vector_and_return
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable, calls the library function at a negative offset from that base, and returns.

name: forward_and_release_on_failure
description: Library routine that passes its last two parameters to a routine, and if that returns a value, calls another routine with the first two parameters and that value. If the second call fails it releases the value through another routine and returns zero.

name: allocate_record_and_store_ten
description: Allocates a fixed-size record with a special flag, stores the value ten in a field of the record and in the caller's word, then passes the record's buffer to another routine. It returns one if the allocation succeeded, otherwise zero.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns zero.

name: verify_library_result_matches
description: Calls a routine with three of its parameters and returns its result when that result equals the fourth parameter, otherwise zero.

name: verify_result_matches_expected
description: Calls a library routine with three of its parameters and returns the result when it equals the fourth parameter, otherwise zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Library routine with no body that only returns.

name: divide_unsigned_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor, running a bit-by-bit loop when the divisor is large and using direct 16-bit division otherwise. It returns the quotient and remainder as a pair.

name: run_restoring_division_loop
description: Performs the sixteen-step bit-by-bit division loop on the dividend register against the divisor, leaving the quotient and remainder in registers. It returns nothing.

name: multiply_16_bit_partial_products
description: Combines 16-bit partial products of two register values to form a 32-bit product, and returns it together with the second value's halves swapped.

name: call_raw_format_routine
description: Calls the exec formatting routine RawDoFmt through a function pointer stored in a global variable and returns nothing.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the first data register to the address held in a pointer register, then returns.

name: measure_c_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a zero-terminated string by counting down a 16-bit value from minus one for each character, stopping at the terminator or when the count wraps. It returns the number of characters.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a zero-terminated string for a given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero if the terminator is reached first.

name: return_zero_without_work
description: Library routine that returns zero and does nothing else.

name: copy_c_string_with_terminator
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer one at a time, including the terminating zero byte.

name: append_c_string
description: Moves to the end of the destination string and copies the source string into that position, including its terminator.

name: compare_strings_up_to_count
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings for at most a given number of bytes. It returns one at the first differing byte, and zero if the strings match within that count or end together.

name: return_one_constant
description: Library routine that does no work and returns one.

name: advance_string_within_count
description: Steps through a string one character at a time while a count stays above zero, and when the terminator is reached calls another routine. It returns nothing.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies characters from a source string into a fixed-size buffer until the terminator or the buffer limit is reached, then fills the rest of the buffer with zero bytes. It returns nothing.

name: initialise_list_header
description: Initialises a list header in place: its first longword is set to point four bytes past the header, the second is cleared, and the third points back to the header itself. It returns nothing.

name: process_structure_if_valid
description: Returns one when given a null structure. Otherwise it calls one routine for the structure and, if that succeeds, calls two more routines, the last using a longword taken from the structure, and returns the final result or zero.

name: walk_node_list_checking
description: Walks a linked list of nodes, running two checks on each node and following its next link. It returns one when every node passes and the list ends, or zero when a check fails.

name: run_checks_along_record_chain
description: Walks a chain of records through their next links, running two checks on each one. It returns one when every record passes and the chain ends, or zero when a check fails.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns zero.

name: allocate_and_link_structure
description: Allocates a structure, runs setup calls on it and stores a result from one call in one of its fields, then returns the structure. It returns zero when the count parameter is zero and minus one when a step fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns minus one.

name: build_linked_structure_chain
description: Repeatedly allocates a structure and links it to the previous one through a field, running setup calls on each, until the requested count is used up. It returns the first structure in the chain, or minus one if a step fails.

name: allocate_structure_chain
description: Allocates structures one after another, linking each to the previous one and running setup calls on each, and returns the first structure once the chain is complete. It returns minus one when any step fails.

name: link_structure_chain_and_finish
description: Repeatedly allocates and links structures, filling fields in each, and returns the first structure once a link is found to be null. It returns minus one if any step fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns minus one.

name: halt_on_unimplemented_instruction
description: Entry stub that contains only an unimplemented instruction, so the decompiler stops here and no library behaviour is shown.

name: store_library_state_values
description: Stores register values into two global variables and a field in a structure, then copies a pointer into another global variable. It returns nothing.

name: forward_call_no_arguments
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: return_no_op_stub
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns.

name: call_another_routine_once
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: clear_flag_and_bump_counter
description: Clears one flag bit in a byte field of a structure and increments a 16-bit counter field in the same structure, then returns the structure pointer.

name: finish_structure_when_idle
description: Returns a global value after checking a counter field in a structure. When the counter is zero it runs cleanup calls on the structure and returns the global value; otherwise it sets a flag bit in the structure and returns zero.

name: free_region_then_return_global
description: Reads a global value, calls a routine on a region computed from two size fields of a structure, and returns the global value.

name: decrement_counter_and_finish
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a structure. When the counter reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls another routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: release_nonzero_library_pointers
description: Calls a library routine on each of several global pointers that is not null, and on two pointer arguments when they are given. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_initialise_library_table
description: Allocates a large block and, if that succeeds, sets many internal pointers inside it, copies template values from a global table into its sections and links some of them. It returns one on success and zero when the allocation fails.

name: initialise_library_structure_pointers
description: Fills several global pointers and fields with addresses computed from a base structure, then copies template values into those sections and links some of them together. It returns one.

name: open_library_set_with_cleanup
description: Opens libraries by name through a library routine, storing each result in a global variable. On failure it records an error code and calls a reporting routine, returning zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: open_icon_and_related_libraries
description: Opens the icon library and the libraries after it, storing each base in a global variable. On failure it records an error code and calls a reporting routine, returning zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: open_intuition_and_second_library
description: Opens intuition.library and a second library, storing each base in a global variable. On failure it records an error code and calls a reporting routine, returning zero; otherwise it returns one.

name: open_graphics_library_checked
description: Opens graphics.library through a library routine and stores its base in a global variable. If the open fails it calls a reporting routine with error code five and returns whether it succeeded.

name: return_one_stub
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns one.

name: get_cached_library_value
description: Looks up a value in a global library structure, returning a cached value when one is stored, otherwise a field from a nested structure. It returns zero when the structure is missing or in a special state.

name: get_library_field_from_structure
description: Reads a field from a structure reached through a pointer, returning a cached value if one is stored and otherwise a value from a nested structure. It returns zero when the structure is missing or in a special state.

name: read_cached_or_nested_field
description: Returns a cached field from a structure if it is set, otherwise follows a nested pointer in the structure to read a field there. It returns zero when that nested pointer is missing.

name: read_field_by_structure_type
description: Returns a field from a nested structure, choosing between the structure's own nested pointer and a second pointer argument according to a type byte. It returns zero when the needed pointer is missing.

name: read_nested_field_or_zero
description: Returns a field from a structure found through a nested pointer, or zero when the pointer argument is null.

name: load_disk_info_entry
description: Reads a value from a disk information file through a local buffer, choosing the file name from a global structure or a default, and returns it. It sets a global flag when the fallback branch is used.

name: lookup_library_status_flag
description: Calls a library routine with a value from a structure and sets a global flag. It returns either that routine's result or a field from a nested structure, depending on a type byte.

name: allocate_and_link_info_buffers
description: Allocates two buffers, checks them against a structure's type and a parameter, copies data between them and sets their size and pointer fields, then allocates a third buffer and links it. It returns one when all steps succeed and zero otherwise.

name: copy_info_entry_fields
description: Stores a value from a library routine into a pointer argument, checks a type byte and an optional parameter, copies data between two structures and sets their fields. It returns one on success and zero otherwise.

name: update_entry_with_type_check
description: Checks a type byte and an optional result from a library routine, then copies fields between two structures, raises a counter to at least 256 and stores a new allocation in a field. Returns one when that allocation is non-null, otherwise zero.

name: update_entry_fields_when_allowed
description: Copies fields between two structures when an optional parameter is zero or a library routine succeeds, raises a counter to at least 256 and stores a new allocation in a field. Returns one when that allocation is non-null, otherwise zero.

name: update_entry_fields_unconditionally
description: Copies fields between two structures, raises a counter to at least 256, and stores a new allocation in a field. It returns whether that allocation is non-null.

name: copy_entry_fields_and_succeed
description: Calls a routine with two fields taken from the structures, stores two more fields from them, and returns one.

name: setup_entry_or_report_error
description: Clears several global variables, allocates a record and runs a sequence of setup and lookup calls on it. It returns on success, and otherwise reports an error code through a routine.

name: setup_stack_entry_or_report
description: Allocates a record for the caller, runs a sequence of setup and link calls on it, and returns on success. Otherwise it reports an error code through a routine taken from a pointer register.

name: link_entry_or_report_error
description: Looks up a value and runs setup and link calls on a record, returning on success. Otherwise it reports an error code through a routine taken from a pointer register.

name: link_global_entry_or_report
description: Looks up a value and runs setup and link calls, returning on success. Otherwise it reports an error code through a routine taken from a pointer register.

name: finish_entry_setup_or_report
description: Looks up a global value and runs several setup calls on a record, returning on success. Otherwise it reports an error code through a routine taken from a pointer register.

name: complete_entry_setup_or_fail
description: Runs a sequence of setup and link calls on a record and returns on success. Otherwise it reports an error code through a routine taken from a pointer register.

name: finish_or_report_entry_status
description: Runs a lookup and, when it succeeds, several setup calls on a record. Either way it reports a status through a routine taken from a pointer register.

name: finalise_entry_and_report_ok
description: Runs a conditional call and four setup calls on a record, then reports a success status through a routine taken from a pointer register. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_minus_132
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 132 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_138
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 138 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_198
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 198 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_210
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 210 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_246
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 246 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_294
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 294 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_372
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 372 from that base. It is called only by the reschedule stub.

name: call_library_vector_minus_414
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 414 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_552
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 552 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_42
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 42 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_96
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 96 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_228
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 228 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_366
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 366 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_72
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 72 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_234
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 234 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_270
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 270 from that base, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_354
description: Library stub that loads a library base from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 354 from that base, then returns.

name: invoke_library_with_param_block
description: Builds a parameter block on the stack from fixed values and a global pointer, then calls a library function with it to obtain a result. If that result is non-null it passes the result to a second library call, and it returns the result.

name: dispatch_by_entry_type
description: Dispatches on a 16-bit type code stored in a structure, running a different sequence of calls for each code. It returns zero for two of the codes and one for the rest.

name: return_one_no_op
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns one.

name: toggle_flag_bit_for_code
description: Maps a 16-bit type code in a structure to a flag bit, toggles that bit in a status field of a global structure, and passes a pointer from the caller to another routine. Unknown codes skip the toggle.

name: store_status_and_forward
description: Stores a register value into a status field of a global structure and calls another routine with a pointer taken from the caller's structure. It returns nothing.

name: build_info_file_name
description: Formats a file name with the info suffix from two strings on the stack, updates a state field for certain type codes, and looks up or creates a related entry through library calls. It returns a boolean for whether the lookup and follow-up checks succeeded.

name: check_disk_info_entries
description: Builds a disk-related name on the stack, checks it through two library calls and several flag values in a structure, and returns zero if any check fails.

name: check_info_file_entries
description: Builds an info file name in stack buffers, looks up related entries through library calls and checks status fields. It clears a result flag when any check fails and returns it.

name: verify_entries_then_finish
description: Calls a routine on four stored fields and checks each result against minus one, returning zero if any is minus one. Otherwise it calls another routine and returns one.

name: check_three_calls_then_finish
description: Calls one function through a pointer three times, returning zero if any call returns minus one. Otherwise it calls another routine and returns one.

name: check_two_calls_then_finish
description: Calls one function through a pointer twice, returning zero if either call returns minus one. Otherwise it calls another routine and returns one.

name: call_pointer_and_report_success
description: Calls a function through a pointer and, when the result is not minus one, calls another routine. It returns whether the result was not minus one.

name: call_routine_then_return_one
description: Calls another routine and returns one.

name: register_info_field_definitions
description: Makes about two dozen calls to a routine with constant values and a pointer from the structure, defining the table entries named NAME, STATUS and TYPE. It returns nothing.

name: register_seven_table_entries
description: Makes seven calls to a routine with a fixed first parameter and constant ranges of values, registering a set of table entries. It returns nothing.

name: register_table_entries_with_flags
description: Makes seven calls to a routine, each with a fixed first parameter and constant ranges, some with a flag of zero and others with a flag of one. It returns nothing.

name: register_info_table_entries
description: Makes nine calls to a routine with a fixed first parameter and constant ranges of values, registering a set of info table entries. It returns nothing.

name: set_info_table_entries
description: Makes nine calls to a routine with a fixed first parameter and six constant values per call, setting a set of info table entries. It returns nothing.

name: add_list_entry_by_type
description: Chooses a size value from a type byte, then adds either a fixed entry or a detailed entry to a list depending on whether the list is empty, and adds an extra entry when a flag is nonzero. It returns nothing.

name: finish_list_entry_add
description: Adds an entry to a list, passing a field from the structure when the list is empty, and adds a further entry when a flag is set. It returns nothing.

name: run_two_list_calls
description: Makes two calls, one using a field of the structure, then a further call on a global entry when a flag is set. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_list_head_with_entries
description: Allocates a list head and initialises its links. Then, for each pointer in a zero-terminated array from the structure, allocates an entry, stores a value and links it into the list. It returns the first entry, or zero if an allocation fails.

name: fill_list_from_pointer_array
description: Walks a zero-terminated array of pointers from the structure, allocating an entry for each, storing a value and linking it into the list, then sets the list's final pointer. It stops early if an allocation fails.

name: append_entries_from_pointer_array
description: Loops over a zero-terminated array of pointers, allocating an entry for each, storing a value and linking it into the list. It returns the last result, or zero when an allocation fails.

name: link_entries_until_array_end
description: Repeatedly allocates an entry, stores a value and links it into the list until a zero-terminated array ends. It then sets the list's final pointer and returns the last result.

name: step_list_cursor_at_boundary
description: Moves a list cursor forward in one of two ways depending on whether it is at a list boundary, calling routines on the entries involved. It returns nothing.

name: update_pointer_from_structure
description: Calls routines on the current list entry, then moves the list's cursor to the entry stored at its forward link. It returns nothing.

name: reset_list_cursor_or_step
description: Processes the current list entry, then either resets the list cursor to the head or steps it to the entry's first link, depending on whether the cursor is at a list boundary. It returns nothing.

name: update_cursor_by_dereference
description: Calls routines on the current list entry, then moves the list cursor to the entry found by dereferencing the cursor. It returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_link_list_entry
description: Sets a global flag, allocates a list entry and a buffer for it, and links the entry into the list, calling routines to update the list. It returns nothing.

name: finish_list_cursor_update
description: Sets a global flag, processes the current list entry, then either finishes the list or moves the cursor to a neighbouring entry, and calls a routine to end the update. It returns nothing.

name: advance_list_cursor_after_call
description: Calls a routine on the current list entry, moves the list cursor to the next entry (or back to the first when the list wraps), then calls another routine. It returns nothing.

name: execute_sequential_callbacks
description: Calls one routine and then two more routines with fields from the structure, in sequence. It returns nothing.

name: build_pointer_table_from_list
description: When a flag is set, counts the entries in a list, allocates an array of pointers with one slot per entry, and fills each slot with a new buffer for its entry. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_pointer_table_from_list
description: Counts the entries in a list, allocates a pointer table with a slot per entry, and walks the list filling each slot with a new buffer. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: allocate_pointer_table_for_list
description: Counts the entries in a list, allocates a pointer table sized to them, and fills each slot with a new buffer while walking the list. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: populate_pointer_table_entries
description: Counts the entries in a list, allocates a pointer table sized to them, and fills each slot with a new buffer. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_table_slots_from_list
description: Walks the list and fills the pointer table slots with new buffers, stopping at the end of the list. It returns one when every slot is filled and zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_remaining_table_slots
description: Continues filling pointer table slots from a list position with new buffers until the list ends. It returns one when the list ends and zero when an allocation fails.

name: continue_table_fill_until_end
description: Walks the remaining list entries, filling pointer table slots with new buffers. It returns one at the end of the list and zero when an allocation fails.

name: register_entries_by_type
description: Switches on a type byte in a structure and makes a different set of calls to a routine for each type, using constant geometry values and a global pointer. It returns nothing.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Library routine with no body that only returns.

name: allocate_type_specific_buffers
description: Allocates four buffers and, when all are non-null, allocates two more and makes a type-specific sequence of calls to a routine. It returns zero when an allocation fails and the type value for unhandled types, otherwise the result of a final routine.

name: run_type_specific_checks
description: Calls a function through a pointer several times and returns zero when any result is missing. Otherwise it makes a type-specific number of calls and returns the result of the final one.

name: run_type_specific_calls
description: Makes a type-dependent number of calls to a routine, one to four depending on a type byte in the structure. It returns nothing.

name: return_no_op_routine
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns.

name: clear_or_copy_then_check
description: Either clears a pointed-to value or copies it through a routine, then calls another routine. It returns that routine's result, or zero when the result is minus one.

name: copy_then_check_result
description: Calls a routine with a stored value, then calls another routine and returns its result, or zero when that result is minus one.

name: return_void_no_op
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns.

name: validate_four_entries
description: Sets position fields in four entries when the type byte is not four, then checks each entry through a routine and returns one only if all four pass.

name: check_three_calls_all_pass
description: Calls one function through a pointer three times and returns one when none of the results is minus one, otherwise zero.

name: check_two_pointer_calls
description: Calls one function through a pointer up to two times and returns zero when either result is minus one, otherwise one.

name: check_pointer_call_not_failed
description: Calls a function through a pointer and returns whether its result is not minus one.

name: return_one_routine
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns one.

name: poll_entries_until_failure
description: Loops indefinitely, looking up entries for a structure and checking each one through a routine, and returns zero as soon as a check fails. When no entry is found it calls a routine with a bit mask derived from a byte in the structure.

name: return_zero_reschedule_hook
description: Library routine called by the reschedule stub. It does nothing and returns zero.

name: dispatch_by_request_code
description: Dispatches on a request code stored in a structure. For the code 64 it returns the result of one routine, for the code 512 it runs a routine and returns zero, and for the other codes it runs routines and returns one.

name: forward_single_call
description: Calls another routine with no arguments and returns nothing.

name: call_routine_then_return_zero
description: Calls another routine and returns zero.

name: execute_two_calls
description: Calls another routine twice and returns one.

name: execute_callbacks_for_structure
description: Calls one routine three times, and a fourth time when a type byte is not one, then calls routines with a structure pointer and a constant. It returns nothing.

name: set_protection_flag_strings
description: Calculates a flag value from a protection field and calls a routine four times, each time testing one bit and passing the matching label for the archived, deleteable, readable and writeable attributes.

name: format_optional_not_text
description: Builds a short string on the stack and formats it with a prefix, choosing between two sets of text pointers depending on a flag. It then calls another routine with computed values and returns nothing.

name: format_string_arguments
description: Builds an argument list on the stack from a global string and a parameter, then calls a formatting routine and two more routines. It returns nothing.

name: count_string_characters
description: Counts the characters in a zero-terminated string starting at the given pointer and returns the count.

name: find_string_terminator
description: Advances from a starting offset to the position of the zero terminator in a string and returns that position.

name: copy_c_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination buffer until the terminating zero byte has been copied.

name: copy_fixed_byte_count
description: Copies a fixed number of bytes from a source buffer into a destination buffer. It returns nothing.

name: copy_memory_block
description: Copies a block of bytes from one buffer to another, using a count as the bound. It returns nothing.

name: compare_strings_by_character
description: Walks two zero-terminated strings while their characters match, then returns whether the characters at the stopping point are equal.

name: compare_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings and returns true when they are equal.

name: count_bytes_including_terminator
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string, including the terminator, and returns that count.

name: execute_library_operations
description: Computes a value from its last parameter, then makes three library calls on a library base taken from a structure, passing the computed value and an adjusted size. It returns nothing.

name: format_stack_buffer_and_call
description: Formats a value from a global string into a local buffer on the stack, then passes the buffer and the caller's parameters to another routine. It returns nothing.

name: copy_length_prefixed_string
description: Copies a length-prefixed string, taking the length from its first byte, into a destination buffer and appends a zero terminator.

name: copy_bytes_and_terminate
description: Copies a run of bytes from a source location into a destination buffer and then writes a zero terminator after them. It returns nothing.

name: initialise_info_entry_structures
description: Fills two structures with fixed field values taken from its parameters, links one to the other, then calls a routine to register the entry and returns whether that call succeeded.

name: execute_library_function
description: Calls a library function through a pointer taken from a structure, and returns one.

name: execute_library_calls
description: Makes three library calls on a library base taken from a structure, passing parameters adjusted by ten for the last call. It returns nothing.

name: invoke_raw_format_through_global
description: Calls the exec formatting routine RawDoFmt through a function pointer stored in a global variable, and returns nothing.

name: write_byte_to_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the first data register to the address held in a pointer register. It returns nothing.

name: call_library_vector_minus_36
description: Library stub that loads a library routine address from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 36, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_minus_72
description: Library stub that loads a library routine address from a global variable and calls the library function at offset minus 72, then returns.

name: return_zero_entry_point
description: Entry routine of the version library that does nothing and returns zero.

name: store_library_pointers
description: Stores two register values into a structure at two fixed offsets and returns. It returns nothing.

name: increment_counter_and_clear_flag
description: Increments a 16-bit counter in a structure and clears one flag bit in a byte of the same structure. It returns nothing.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a structure. When it reaches zero and a flag bit is set, it calls another routine and returns its result; otherwise it returns zero.

name: finish_or_flag_structure
description: If the counter in a structure is zero, it calls two library functions and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the structure and returns zero.

name: get_library_value
description: Reads a stored value from a structure, calls two library functions through base offsets, and returns the value.

name: return_zero_no_op
description: Library routine that does nothing and returns zero.

name: allocate_and_store_font_entry
description: Calls a library routine to obtain an entry and, when that succeeds, stores a value in it and calls a second library routine. It returns whether the entry was obtained.
